name: Naveen Inukollu
title: Authentic & perfectly balanced
body: The veg mixed pickle is very tasty and well-balanced. The vegetables are fresh, spices are perfect, and the flavor is authentic. Not too oily or too spicy — just right. Goes very well with rice and curd.

name: Dinesh M
title: Nothing like this in the market
body: You would not get this taste from any branded pickles in the market. Totally worth ordering for its authenticity and traditional tastes. Feels like homemade pickle from a Telugu kitchen.

name: Madhavi Villuri
title: Chicken pickle is awesome
body: We received the order just now. Chicken pickle taste is awesome. Super packing. No leakage. We are from Bangalore. Thank you Babai.

name: Suresh P
title: Fresh and authentic
body: Really, the pickle taste was awesome. Fresh and full of authentic flavour!

name: Divya Sarika
title: Especially the vegetable pickle
body: Excellent taste of Andhra pickles. Especially the vegetable pickle is very tasty.

name: Verified Buyer
title: Amma pachadi laga undi
body: Really awesome and tasty, no words to say that much super, amma pachidi laga undi.
